resources.string: Ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock when EchoLedger opens.
Set a screen lock on this phone to use App lock.
Install the latest security update to use App lock.
Hide content in Recents and screenshots
Off by default, so you can take screenshots of the app. EchoLedger\'s floating windows are always a black box in screenshots unless you choose Show in During screen sharing.
Hide recording titles on the widget
The home-screen widget then says \"WhatsApp call\" or \"Voice note\". With App lock on it shows no recordings.
Recording laws differ by country. Tell the people in your meeting that you are recording where the law requires it. A recording notification is always shown.
EchoLedger\'s floating windows are the recording controls, captions, the after-call card and Live Translate.
In a screen share, recording or screenshot, the floating windows are a black box. You see them as usual.
Android doesn\'t tell apps when a floating window is in a screen share, so the black box is always on unless you choose Show.
Couldn\'t load the server\'s storage. Check the connection.
Recordings are deleted after %1$s unless kept.
Deleted recordings can be restored for %1$s.
